cs.t: 1, $100: Fenix LED headlamp, 1200 lum, with red light, made from lightweight magnesium alloy with magnet, waterproof. I use it almost daily, for bike, for work, for reading (red light), camping... 2, $1000 E-reader (Onyx Boox). I never read that much before. Ability to highligh text, make notes by pen and have it in readable, indexable format is something that I miss on paper books.
cs.th: Ask HN: Life-changing purchases since 2020? (Under $100 and under $1000)
